continuity: Taekyung’s force of roughly three thousand has traveled from Tianshui through Lanzhou and is approaching the Qilian Mountains; a battle is expected soon.
Wolhwa’s latest missive to Taekyung includes personal, affectionate language as well as a wish that they meet again.
Namho’s serious, undisclosed matter for Taekyung remains unresolved.
The six Baekma Bang men left to fetch the Lord within five days of the march’s halt; Ma Junggeol remains with Taekyung’s group.
Sama Pyo disobeyed Sima Gong’s order to return to Gansu; the consequences remain unknown.
plot: A force of three thousand martial artists races west from Tianshui, passing Lanzhou and entering the Hexi Corridor as it approaches the Qilian Mountains. On the march, Taekyung talks with Ju Hwaran about how difficult trust and relationships can be, then discovers that a missive from Wolhwa contains an unusually affectionate personal message. Hwaran’s pointed questions and sudden ride ahead leave Taekyung awkwardly trying to explain their relationship.
translation_decisions: Keep Wolhwa’s closing image of the Yellow River running clear as an auspicious wish to meet again.
